description: Normal-map modes off the recorded opacities and on an exactly flat normal (compositor-blend-gaps.md section 5, decision 067): s0-s2 NormalMapCombine, NormalMapDetail and NormalMapInverseDetail of fields B over fields A at upper opacity 0.1, 1/3, 0.7 and 0.99 (User0-User3 RGB32F, User4-User7 RGB16); s3-s5 the same modes with the uniform normal (0.5, 0.5, 1.0): flat under fields B, fields A under flat and flat under flat at 0.5, flat under flat at 1, on each format; s6-s7 the empty stack.
